description: "Your data choices" for the signed-in person (L24): GET /api/v1/me/consent lists every purpose with its wording, the person's choices and their history; PUT /api/v1/me/consent/:purpose turns one on or off (network.consent-choice@1); DELETE /api/v1/me/consent/:purpose/:client revokes one app. Off is the default for every purpose. Only the person's own session or token reaches it.
